intuition: Every combination is an increasing sequence of k choices from 1 through n, so choosing each next value avoids duplicate permutations.

brute_force.approach: Generate all subsets of the range and retain those with exactly k elements.

optimal.approach: Backtrack over increasing candidates and stop each branch once k values have been chosen.

edge_cases: When k equals n, there is one combination containing every value.
The increasing candidate order prevents duplicate arrangements.
Backtrack by removing each appended choice before trying the next.
